title: skinheat: code and data for 'Exact exponential heat rectification from the Liouvillian skin effect'

creators.name: Wakaura, Hikaru
creators.affiliation: QIRI (Quantum Integrated Research Institute Inc.), Tokyo, Japan

creators.name: Tanimae, Taiki
creators.affiliation: QIRI (Quantum Integrated Research Institute Inc.), Tokyo, Japan

description: Python package (Gaussian quadratic-Lindbladian solver, non-Hermitian Landauer transmissions, superfermion matrix-product-state Lindblad solver), reproduction scripts, test suite, all result files and the figure generator for the Letter 'Exact exponential heat rectification from the Liouvillian skin effect' (H. Wakaura and T. Tanimae). Every figure of the Letter and its Supplemental Material regenerates from the included JSON data with paper/make_figures.py.
